---
title: Documentation
description: If people don't understand a feature, they won't use it. Documentation is part of done.
---

This site is the product's front door. A feature, connector, pack or command without a page here is
not finished.

## The rules

1. **Every user-facing change ships with its page** in the same pull request: a guide for BIM users,
   a reference entry for commands, and a build page for extension points.
2. **Write for the reader who doesn't code.** BIM professionals and managers first; technical detail
   goes under "Build on bimai".
3. **Be honest about status.** Every page that describes something not yet built says so, with the
   `Status` marker.
4. **Show, don't describe.** A diagram, an example conversation or a table beats a paragraph.
5. **Checked in CI.** The site must build; links must resolve; every command and every pack must have
   a page. A missing page fails the build.

## How to add a page

Pages live in `docs/content/docs/` as MDX. Mermaid code blocks render as diagrams.

```bash
cd docs
npm install
npm run dev      # preview on http://localhost:3000
```

## Agents read the docs too

The site publishes `llms.txt` and a Markdown version of every page, so bimai's own agents (the Mentor in
particular) answer "how do I…" questions from the same documentation people read.
